You match readings by paraphrase. Below are a SENTENCE, the DEMAND inside it, and three numbered lists of readings of the DEMAND: A and B (from two auditors) and L (from a parser). Two readings match when they require, forbid or permit the same acts, each on its own or together in the same way, with every modifier applying to the same acts; wording does not matter. Pair the A and B readings that match, each A and each B reading in at most one pair. For each pair name the L reading that matches it, or NONE; each L reading in at most one pair. Then name every L reading in which a modifier applies to some of the joined items but not to an item between them (a skipped middle). Use only the text below; do not use tools or outside knowledge. Answer with one line per pair, `PAIR A<i> B<j> L<k>` or `PAIR A<i> B<j> NONE`, then exactly one line `SKIPPED: NONE` or `SKIPPED: L<k>, L<m>, ...`, and nothing else.

SENTENCE: 1. Everyone has the right to seek and to enjoy in other countries asylum from persecution.
DEMAND: Everyone has the right to seek and to enjoy in other countries asylum from persecution
In list L, {0} stands for everyone.
A1. Everyone has two separate rights: to seek asylum from persecution, wherever they seek it, and to enjoy asylum from persecution in other countries.
A2. Everyone has two separate rights: to seek asylum from persecution in other countries, and to enjoy asylum from persecution in other countries.
A3. Everyone has a single combined right: to seek asylum from persecution and then enjoy it in other countries. Seeking asylum is protected only as part of seeking and enjoying it together, and seeking may happen anywhere.
A4. Everyone has a single combined right: to seek and enjoy asylum from persecution in other countries. Both seeking and enjoying must take place in other countries.
B1. Everyone may seek asylum from persecution in other countries, and, as a separate right, everyone may enjoy asylum from persecution in other countries. Each right holds on its own.
B2. Everyone may seek asylum from persecution in another country from anywhere, including their own country, and, as a separate right, may enjoy that asylum in other countries. Here "in other countries" says where the asylum is, not where the seeking must happen.
B3. Everyone has a single combined right to seek asylum from persecution in other countries and then enjoy it there. Seeking without being able to enjoy it is not separately protected.
B4. Everyone has a single combined right to seek asylum from persecution from anywhere and then enjoy it in other countries. "In other countries" limits only the enjoying.
L1. {0} has the right to seek asylum from persecution, and {0} has the right to enjoy asylum from persecution in other countries.
L2. {0} has the right to seek asylum from persecution in other countries, and {0} has the right to enjoy asylum from persecution in other countries.
